fullPassage: Dear Mayor Stanton, I've recently been informed that you are proposing a plan to renovate our city's great historic landmark, the Silverlight Theater. Your proposed plan to increase the theater's seating capacity to attract larger audiences and bring more world-class theatrical performances to the city may be financially sound. But everything I've heard and read in recent weeks leads me to believe that such a renovation would destroy the theater's architecture, which is among the best of its kind in the nation. With that in mind, I urge you to reconsider this renovation plan and to explore alternatives that will preserve the character of the Silverlight Theater while securing its financial stability. I strongly believe that we should not sacrifice the beauty and history of our city for short-sighted financial gain. Sincerely, Kate Hendricks

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ③ increasing → to increase: plan to increase(~하려는 계획)에서 to부정사가 plan을 수식. 동명사 불가.
det.analysis:

❌ ② proposing — you are proposing: 현재진행형 적절
✅ ③ increasing — 원문 to increase. plan to increase에서 to부정사 필요. increasing 부적절 ←정답
❌ ④ larger — larger audiences: 비교급 형용사 적절

❌ ③ which — architecture, which is: 계속적 관계대명사 적절

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: '향상시키다(enhance)'가 아니라 '파괴하다(destroy)'가 적절. 리노베이션이 건축물을 파괴할 것이란 우려.
det.analysis:

❌ ② preserve — 성격을 보존하다, 원문 일치
❌ ③ sacrifice — 아름다움과 역사를 희생하다, 원문 일치
❌ ④ short-sighted — 근시안적 재정 이득, 원문 일치

questions.passage: Dear Mayor Stanton, I've recently been informed that you are proposing a plan to renovate our city's great historic landmark, the Silverlight Theater. Your proposed plan to increase the theater's seating capacity to attract larger audiences and bring more world-class theatrical performances to the city may be financially sound. But everything I've heard and read in recent weeks leads me to believe that such a renovation would destroy the theater's architecture, which is among the best of <u>its</u> kind in the nation. With that in mind, I urge you to reconsider this renovation plan and to explore alternatives that will preserve the character of the Silverlight Theater while securing its financial stability. I strongly believe that we should not sacrifice the beauty and history of our city for short-sighted financial gain. Sincerely, Kate Hendricks
